description: This file defines the KilocodeEventProcessor class responsible for handling Kilocode stream events, managing message state, and communicating with a webview for state machine transitions in a chat or agent system.

classes.name: KilocodeEventProcessor
classes.description: Main class for processing Kilocode stream events, managing session messages, and coordinating state transitions.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming stream events, updates message state, and triggers appropriate state events and UI updates.

methods.name: sendStateEventForMessage
methods.description: Determines and sends appropriate state machine events based on the payload content.

methods.name: deriveMessageText
methods.description: Generates message text from payload, handling special cases like checkpoints and command outputs.

methods.name: formatToolAskText
methods.description: Formats descriptive text for tool-related ask messages based on metadata.

methods.name: getMessageKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for deduplicating messages, especially command outputs.
